remarks: Nestled on 2.64 pristine acres near the New Canaan border, this custom-built estate is on the market for the first time. Thoughtfully designed and impeccably maintained, it showcases superior craftsmanship, modern amenities, and an unparalleled setting. Included is a 1.14-acre flat building lot with separate cul-de-sac access, ideal for expansion, a guest house, or investment.  Built with 2'x6' construction for durability and energy efficiency, the home features a whole-house generator, gourmet kitchen, and four masonry fireplaces. The estate boasts a heated pool, full pool house, upgraded tennis court, and private golf green. A full basement with 9'+ ceilings allows for endless customization.  With a heated three-car garage, five-bedroom septic system, and full-property irrigation, this estate blends elegance, privacy, and convenience. Schedule your private tour today.
